stories.title: Reliance to build Campa Cola plant in Karnataka
stories.summary: Reliance Group will invest ₹1,600 crore to establish a Campa Cola manufacturing plant in Karnataka. The 109-acre facility in Vijayapura is expected to create 2,000 direct and 3,000 indirect jobs. The foundation stone was laid on November 16 to provide momentum to local industrial development.

stories.title: Amazon plans $7 billion renewable energy push in India
stories.summary: Amazon announced plans to procure $7 billion in renewable energy in India by 2030, adding to its existing $4 billion commitment. The investment aims to help the company reduce the carbon intensity of its global operations by 65 percent. Every unit of electricity will soon be cleaner.

stories.title: India horticulture production hits record 386.92 million tonnes
stories.summary: India’s horticulture production reached a record 386.92 million tonnes in 2025-26, up from 370.74 million tonnes the previous year. Despite a reduction in total crop area to 29.72 million hectares, higher yields across various crops drove the increase. The government had previously estimated a lower output in June.

stories.title: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility wins Earthshot Prize
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility won the 2026 Earthshot Prize in the Clean Our Air category, receiving a £1 million grant. The company reports selling 400,000 electric commercial vehicles in India, which have collectively traveled 9 billion kilometers. The prize recognizes efforts to promote electric last-mile transportation.

stories.title: Government governance to prioritize citizen experience
stories.summary: Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister P K Mishra stated that the next phase of Indian governance should focus on the quality of citizen experience rather than the volume of programs administered. Officials emphasized outcome-based reviews and leadership to support the vision for 2047. Government is now one.

stories.title: Quad leaders warn against economic coercion
stories.summary: Leaders from the US, India, Japan and Australia expressed grave concerns regarding economic coercion and arbitrary export restrictions. The group stated its opposition to unilateral actions that escalate regional tensions. Members are currently focusing on supply chain security and the deployment of trusted artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Gadkari approves ₹1,483 crore for Delhi-Agra corridor
stories.summary: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari approved ₹1,123.56 crore for infrastructure on the Delhi-Agra corridor and ₹359.63 crore for West Delhi road projects. The corridor work includes three road over bridges and four flyovers to manage traffic for 68,000 passenger car units. The projects aim to improve connectivity.

stories.title: Odisha adopts three-year spending ceilings
stories.summary: Odisha expects its 2027-28 budget to rise by 8 to 10 percent, supported by a 13 percent increase in state revenue. The government is introducing three-year spending ceilings to manage its fiscal trajectory. Departments have been instructed to submit their expenditure proposals by December 19.

stories.title: States report narrowing fiscal deficits
stories.summary: States' combined fiscal deficit is budgeted to narrow to 2.9 percent of GDP in 2026-27, down from 3.4 percent the previous year. A report by PRS Legislative Research notes that nine states have exceeded the 3 percent limit recommended by the 16th Finance Commission.

stories.title: State spending on subsidies rises to 21 percent
stories.summary: State spending on subsidies and transfers increased from 16 percent of revenue receipts in 2018-19 to 21 percent in 2023-24. Cash transfer schemes are estimated to account for 1 percent of GDP in 2026-27, up from 0.6 percent in 2022-23. Power subsidies remain a primary expenditure.

stories.title: Jindal calls for level playing field in steel
stories.summary: Jindal Steel Chairman Naveen Jindal stated that India supports fair trade but must prevent unfairly priced imports from undermining domestic manufacturing. He emphasized the need for policy predictability in energy and logistics. The industry is currently working to align itself with India's broader climate journey.

stories.title: Draft sustainable aviation fuel policy expected soon
stories.summary: The Centre expects to release a draft sustainable aviation fuel policy for public consultation within two weeks. The framework focuses on institutional coordination and public-private partnerships to boost production. The draft has been shared with the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas for review.

stories.title: Nifty Bank hits record high after monthly rally
stories.summary: The Nifty Bank index reached a lifetime high for the second consecutive session, gaining 11.5 percent over the past month. Analysts attribute the rally to strong banking fundamentals and renewed interest from foreign investors. The index closed at 62,442.2, erasing previous year-to-date losses.

stories.title: Foreign inflows drive banking stocks to record
stories.summary: Banking stocks pushed the Nifty Bank index to an all-time high of 62,273.5 as foreign investors increased their holdings. Twelve of the 14 index stocks rallied, with Punjab National Bank leading the gains. Several banks, including ICICI and Union Bank, reached new all-time highs.

stories.title: Rupee reaches seven-month high
stories.summary: The rupee appreciated to 93.5 against the US dollar, its strongest level since April. The 42.5 paise gain was supported by falling crude oil prices and foreign portfolio investor interest. Market participants noted that oil marketing companies also utilized the central bank's special dollar window.

stories.title: Indian stocks lead Asia with monthly gains
stories.summary: Indian equities recouped losses from the US-Iran conflict, with the Nifty 50 and Sensex reaching new intraday highs on Tuesday. The market has become Asia’s top performer this month, rising 0.4 percent and 0.5 percent respectively. Analysts suggest there is room for further growth.

stories.title: Bank Nifty reaches record close
stories.summary: Bank Nifty closed at a record 62,273.25 on Tuesday, rising 1.13 percent. The broader market followed, with the Sensex gaining 0.52 percent. While Wall Street technology stocks faced pressure from AI trade unwinds, Indian markets continued to see inflows from foreign institutional investors.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty extend rally
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices extended gains for a second day, driven by foreign fund inflows and stable crude oil prices. The Sensex climbed 427.40 points, while the Nifty reached 25,387.40. The local market showed resilience despite broader declines across Asian, European and US equity markets.

stories.title: Bank Nifty hits record high as markets rally
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices rose on November 17, with Nifty closing at 25,387.40 and Sensex at 82,532.19. Bank Nifty reached a fresh all-time high, supported by institutional buying and easing crude oil prices. While banking and realty sectors gained, IT stocks underperformed and overall market breadth remained weak.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty reach highest levels since February
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices closed at their highest since late February on Tuesday, driven by record foreign portfolio inflows of $9.53 billion this month. Despite weakness in Asian peers, the Nifty 50 and Sensex gained 0.38% and 0.52% respectively. Eleven of the 16 major sectors advanced during the session.

stories.title: Sensex Today Ends 427 Points Higher | Nifty Above 25,350 | Nifty Bank Hits Record High - Equitymaster
Nifty and Sensex climb as realty sector lags
stories.summary: Markets ended higher on Tuesday, with Nifty closing at 25,387.40 and Sensex at 82,532.19. Diversified stocks led the rally, while consumer durables and realty sectors faced profit-taking. Corporate activity remained focused on Equitas Small Finance Bank following a new executive appointment and upcoming conference participation.

stories.title: Bank Nifty hits record high as markets extend gains
stories.summary: The Bank Nifty reached a fresh all-time high on Tuesday, pushing the Nifty 50 above the 25,400 resistance level. Gains were driven by broad-based institutional buying and lower crude oil prices. ICICI Bank, Axis Bank and SBI emerged as the primary contributors to the banking index rally.

Signature Global enters Mumbai market with Raigad land purchase
stories.summary: Delhi-NCR developer Signature Global has entered the Mumbai Metropolitan Region after acquiring 474.66 acres in Raigad for ₹194.19 crore. The land was secured through an online auction, marking the company's first expansion into the region beyond its core market. The cost averaged ₹40.9 lakh per acre.

stories.title: T-Series and Hungama launch FastTV with ₹300 crore investment
stories.summary: T-Series and Hungama Digital Media Entertainment have launched FastTV, a joint venture platform dedicated to micro-drama. The companies committed ₹300 crore to fund original content and technology. The platform will offer serialized stories in short episodes designed for mobile viewing across 190 countries.

stories.title: SoftBank reduces Meesho stake in ₹1,885 crore sale
stories.summary: SoftBank Group has sold a 1.65% stake in e-commerce platform Meesho for ₹1,885 crore. The transaction, involving 7.64 crore shares, reduces the investor's holding to 5.19%. Societe Generale was the largest buyer in the deal, which also saw participation from domestic mutual funds and overseas institutional investors.

stories.title: Redbrick Offices secures ₹530 crore in second funding round
stories.summary: Abakkus Four2Eight Opportunities Fund led a ₹530 crore funding round for Redbrick Offices. The capital is intended to expand the company's enterprise footprint and technology integration to meet demand from Global Capability Centres. Investors have committed to the full amount subject to standard closing conditions.

stories.title: Block Deals: Ribbit Capital sells Groww stake worth Rs 1,905 crore, Happy Forgings promoters offload 1.7%... - Moneycont
Prestige Estates acquires 50% stake in Mumbai commercial project
stories.summary: Prestige Estates Projects has acquired a 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for a commercial project in Andheri East, Mumbai. The development spans 1.50 million square feet with an estimated gross development value of ₹4,500 crore. The acquisition was completed through a wholly owned subsidiary.

stories.title: Fairfax to sell IIFL Finance stake to fund IDBI Bank acquisition
stories.summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings plans to sell its entire 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance through a block deal on November 18. The sale aims to unlock funds for the company's pending acquisition of IDBI Bank. The shares are being offered at a floor price of ₹611 apiece.

stories.title: Fairfax to exit IIFL Finance via ₹3,454 crore block deal
stories.summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings intends to sell its 13.25% stake in IIFL Finance at ₹611 per share. The transaction is expected to generate ₹3,454 crore, which the firm will use to help finance its ₹52,878-crore acquisition of a majority stake in IDBI Bank from the government and LIC.

stories.title: Megha Engineering's Krishna Reddy raises Rs 7,000 crore from global funds to buy out uncle's stake - Moneycontrol.com
Persistent Systems secures ₹7,600 crore for Nagarro acquisition
stories.summary: Persistent Systems has raised ₹7,600 crore to finance its proposed acquisition of German-listed Nagarro SE. The package includes ₹7,000 crore in non-convertible debentures and ₹600 crore in commercial papers. Khaitan and Co served as legal advisors for the financing and general corporate funding requirements.

stories.title: IIFL Finance Block Deal: FIH Mauritius To Sell 13% Stake In Rs 3,454-Crore Clean-Out Trade, Check Floor Price - NDTV Pro
Booking.com finds travellers want to be unconventional
stories.summary: Booking.com reports that 89 per cent of Indian travellers want to do something completely out of character on holiday, while 65 per cent aim to surprise their families with their destination. The company says travellers now prioritise emotional states and strict budget filters. Holidays are now a performance.

stories.title: Generali Central Life Insurance adds waiver rider
stories.summary: Generali Central Life Insurance has introduced a waiver of premium rider for eligible plans. Policyholders can stop paying premiums if they suffer accidental disability, a critical illness, or death. The insurer says benefits will continue as planned. The policy remains alive, provided the conditions are met.

stories.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana returns explained
stories.summary: The government-backed Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana offers an 8.2 per cent interest rate for the current quarter. Parents contributing 5,000 rupees monthly for 15 years can accumulate approximately 27.73 lakh rupees by the 21-year maturity mark. The scheme allows interest to accrue even after contributions cease.

stories.title: Accessing four free credit reports in India
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India mandates that each of the four credit information companies provide individuals with one free credit report annually. Residents can access reports from TransUnion CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, and CRIF High Mark without subscription fees. Monitoring debt is now a four-part annual ritual.

stories.title: Home insurance gaps in flat coverage
stories.summary: Home insurance policies can cover fire, short circuits, or monsoon flooding, with annual premiums starting around 2,300 rupees. Coverage is subject to specific terms and conditions. Without a policy, repair bills for damages like stray rockets landing on balconies remain the sole responsibility of the owner.

stories.title: Investors weigh LRS transfers amid curb speculation
stories.summary: Speculation that the Reserve Bank of India may introduce sub-limits on Liberalised Remittance Scheme transactions has prompted some investors to move funds early. No official announcement regarding new restrictions has been made. Investors are currently acting on the possibility of rules that do not yet exist.

stories.title: Borrowing against rising gold prices
stories.summary: Rising gold prices increase the loan amount available to borrowers pledging jewellery as collateral. While higher eligibility provides more funds for emergencies, it does not change the repayment obligation. Borrowing more simply because the collateral value has increased is a decision that requires careful financial assessment.

stories.title: ITAT rules on cancelled property bookings
stories.summary: The Mumbai bench of the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal ruled that rights from a property allotment letter qualify as a capital asset. Surrendering these rights for compensation can trigger capital gains tax. A cancelled booking is now officially a taxable transfer of assets.

stories.title: EPFO launches WhatsApp balance checks
stories.summary: EPFO members can now check balances and view recent transactions via WhatsApp. The service, launched on 1 November 2026, requires a registered mobile number linked to a Universal Account Number. The portal is no longer the only way to see where the money went.

stories.title: UPI marks a decade of digital payments
stories.summary: Unified Payments Interface has become the default payment method for many across India, shifting behaviour from debit to digital. Industry players are now using the platform to build new businesses. The next generation of the interface is currently being discussed at various growth and innovation forums.

stories.title: The debate over UPI sustainability
stories.summary: As the digital payments ecosystem matures, stakeholders are debating the future of the merchant discount rate and how to sustain the platform. Third-party providers and merchants are weighing the costs of participation. The era of free transactions is being reconsidered by those who pay.

stories.title: High Court rules on pension deductions for guarantors
stories.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court recently examined a case where a bank deducted loan EMIs from a retired official's pension after the primary borrower defaulted. The court reviewed the liability of guarantors in such instances. Pension accounts are not always immune to recovery efforts.
